title: The Harness canvas runs as a governed mission with an AI-proposed team bound to models from the model list
user_story: As the owner I want Harness to form its agent team with AI, bind every agent to a model from the app's model list (Codex for live tests), and actually run the canvas through the governed mission runtime instead of blocking every agent node (Playwright 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A9).

requirements.description: POST /api/harness/team/propose asks the chosen architect model (from the model list) for 1-4 agents with role, purpose, prompt, tools and a model from the list; the app refuses unknown tools, unlisted models, duplicate ids and non-JSON answers, and keeps unavailable models marked, never swapped.
GET /api/harness/models lists the provider registry without Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Hermes and the router; local engines count as available only after a short cached probe answers.

POST /api/harness/compile turns the canvas into an L2/L3 MissionSpec: agent and code nodes become agent.task on the agent's model and tools, literature paper.discover, paper writing paperorchestra.full_orchestration, approvals review.checkpoint, evaluation gates artifact.verify (with a note), End mission.report; conditions, loops, unknown roles, more than 3 model steps and L4 are refused with the reason. create=true stores a draft for plan approval.

agent.task runs only on its bound model (CLI agents through research.run_coding with a grant carrying the agent's registry tools; local engines locally; cloud only with API billing allowed); an unavailable model pauses the mission and nothing else runs; review.checkpoint waits in awaiting_step_review until the researcher reviews it.

nonfunctional: No hidden or hardcoded model; no substitution
Session instruction files are never returned as agent outputs
Local engine probe at most 5 s, cached 30 s
inputs: POST /api/harness/compile {workflow, topic_id, level, team, objective, create}
preconditions: research_os.enabled and team_enabled for a team mission to run (it pauses with the reason otherwise)
postconditions: Every agent step of a Harness canvas runs inside an approved mission on the model the team bound to it
acceptance_criteria: Harness Studio Team tab (architect model, AI proposal, per-agent model with unavailable state, compiled steps and notes, draft linked to Missions): MissionTeamPanel.test.tsx 3/3 and harness_levels.spec.ts HARNESS-LEVELS-004 at L2 and L3 in the offline CI browser run

scenarios.expected: The architect sees models with availability and the tool catalog; bad tools, models, duplicates, sizes and prose are refused; an unavailable model is kept and marked
The architect canvas becomes 8 typed tasks with bound models, a gate note and a draft mission with researcher, coder and coordinator roles
Conditions, L4 and a missing role are refused with the reason; one agent may take every agent node
The agent task runs on cli:codex with its role and tools, its file is an artifact, the checkpoint waits, the review continues to the report and L3 final review
An unavailable model pauses the mission with 'No other model is tried'; no CLI, local or cloud call happens
Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Hermes and the router are never offered or bound
An unreachable local engine is unavailable; an answering one is READY with its model
A team agent's grant carries exactly its registry tools; plain CLI grants carry none; session instruction files are not outputs
Model list, compile preview, draft creation and 400 errors through the real API

recovery: Fix at team_agents/harness_compile; never substitute a model, drop a canvas node silently or run an agent outside an approved mission. TASK-HARNESS-TEAM-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR with real missions, team validation, approvals and step reviews (tests/_env.py); the CLI gateway and the architect's answer are fixed in unit tests; live Codex runs on the disposable QA server are recorded in docs/qa/evidence/harness-team-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 9 tests on 20efd5d, all 9 failing (no team agents, compiler, agent.task or checkpoint). GREEN: 9/9.
